race.comment: VALEDOR (14) making rapid progress in his first prep and comes to town with a solid record. Stretched out to the 1600m with a comfortable victory at Scone with plenty in reserve. Back to the 1300m here and look for him savaging the line. Go close. BROOKLYN LIGHTS (2) placed in this grade last prep and returned with a tough on pace win over 1280m at Canberra Acton. Key jockey change from the good draw and will prove hard to get past. ZOUSANITY (17) strengthened over the break with the two sharp wins at Tamworth and Gunnedah. Deserves her chance in this grade and drops in weight from the low gate. Each way. WHATELEY (10) returns from a let-up. Sat on the speed and found plenty over the closing stages when second over 1500m at this track. Gets in light with the claim and stays in the mix. SHE WITHIN (7) at her top for this and looks well placed with the claim. Don't dismiss.
